methodologyNotes: Covers self-contained wireless microphone systems built around clip-on/lavalier bodypack transmitters paired with a receiver, sold as a complete kit at a published US MSRP, aimed at content creation, filmmaking, interviews, and mobile journalism. Excludes handheld-only stage/vocal systems sold without a clip-on transmitter, in-ear monitor systems, wired lavaliers, and bare lavalier capsules. Price is typical US retail or MSRP in USD for the standard kit as configured (transmitterCount below). rfBandType is the operating RF band as an enum: '2.4GHz' (2.4 GHz digital), 'UHF', or '2.4GHz+BT' (2.4 GHz digital with Bluetooth output). transmitterCount is the number of clip-on transmitters included in the priced kit, as a count. rangeMeters is the manufacturer-rated maximum line-of-sight operating range in meters. txBatteryLifeHrs is single-transmitter runtime on its internal battery in hours. totalBatteryHrs is total system runtime including the charging case in hours; null if the kit ships without a charging case. onboardRecordingHrs is internal transmitter recording capacity in hours; null if the transmitter cannot record internally. bitDepthFloat is a boolean: true if the system supports 32-bit float internal recording. latencyMs is manufacturer-stated end-to-end audio latency in milliseconds; null if not disclosed. maxSplDb is the maximum sound pressure level the capsule handles in dB SPL; null if not disclosed. noiseCancellation is a boolean: true if the system provides onboard DSP noise cancellation. outputInterface is the receiver output connector as an enum: 'USB-C', '3.5mm-TRS', 'Lightning', or 'XLR'. weightGramsTx is single-transmitter weight in grams.

products.name: DJI Mic 3
products.priceNote: US regular price $259.00 for the standard "DJI Mic 3 (2 TX + 1 RX + Charging Case)" kit, per the DJI USA online store (djiusa.com), which shows a $259.00 regular price and a current $219.00 sale price. The same 259 figure appears as 259 EUR on the DJI EU store. Used the $259.00 regular/MSRP figure.
products.provenance: The official DJI Mic 3 spec page confirmed the exact model via component model numbers DMT03 (transmitter), DMR03 (receiver), and DMC03 (charging case), and stated the 400 m max transmission range, 8 h transmitter runtime, 126 dB SPL (@1% THD) max SPL, 16 g transmitter weight, omnidirectional pattern, 32-bit float/24-bit switchable recording, receiver output over 3.5mm TRS and USB-C, and dual-band 2.4/5 GHz + Bluetooth 5.4 operation. The DJI USA online store page for "DJI Mic 3 (2 TX + 1 RX + Charging Case)" corroborated the same standard two-transmitter kit, stated the US regular price of $259.00 (currently on sale at $219.00), the up-to-28-hour total runtime with the charging case, and 57.3 h (24-bit single-file) internal recording capacity. Both pages describe the identical DJI Mic 3 standard kit, not a sibling (Mic 2 / Mic Mini) or the 1 TX / 4 TX variants.

products.name: DJI Mic Mini
products.priceNote: US MSRP $169 for the complete DJI Mic Mini kit (2 TX + 1 RX + Charging Case), the configuration priced here. TechRadar review (dated Dec 2024): "$169 / £145 / AU$245 for the compete kit with 2x mics, receiver and charging case" and "the complete kit, which includes two transmitters, a receiver and a charging case, costs $169". Independently corroborated by Newsshooter (article dated 2024-11-26): "The DJI Mic Mini (2 TX + 1 RX + Charging Case) retails for $169 USD".
products.provenance: The DJI manufacturer specs page (dji.com/mic-mini/specs) confirmed the exact model via transmitter model DMMT01 and receiver model DMMR01, listing single-transmitter weight ~10 g, 2.4 GHz operation with Bluetooth 5.3, max transmission range 400 m, and max SPL of "120 dB SPL". The dated TechRadar review (Dec 2024) corroborates the same exact model and its US price — "$169 ... for the compete kit with 2x mics, receiver and charging case" — plus 11.5 h transmitter / 10.5 h receiver battery and up to 48 h with the fully charged case; Newsshooter (2024-11-26) also states "$169 USD" for this 2 TX + 1 RX + Charging Case kit. Both confirm this is the complete charging-case kit (not the 1 TX + 1 RX variant), and TechRadar notes the Mic Mini lacks the Mic 2's 32-bit float (records 24-bit), so bitDepthFloat is false; internal recording and latency are not disclosed, hence null.

products.name: RODE Wireless PRO

No valid US MSRP is on either cited page — RODE shows no price and Thomann shows a euro-derived "$229" not representative of US retail (actual typical US price is $299) — so priceUsd is left null.

products.name: Saramonic Ultra

products.provenance: Fetched the official Saramonic global product page (saramonic.com/product/ultra), which identifies the exact model as the "Saramonic Ultra — Ultimate 2-Channel Wireless Microphone System with Timecode" and provides a full transmitter spec table: Max SPL 130 dB, Latency 25 ms, Transmission Range 300 m (with external antenna), transmitter Battery Life 6 hours, transmitter Weight 35 g, 48 kHz/32-bit float onboard recording, ClearVoice noise cancellation, and a 2× transmitter kit. Corroborated on Saramonic's official US store (saramonicusa.com), which lists the base 2-person Ultra kit (SKU ULTRA01) at MSRP "$239.00" and states the included 2900 mAh charging case provides "two full system charges, enabling up to 18 hours of operation" (used for totalBatteryHrs=18, matching TX 6 h × 3 runtimes; the global site's spec-table "24 hours" figure was not used as it conflicts with two other official sources). The 2.4 GHz operating band is stated as "Connectivity Technology: 2.4GHz" on the Amazon product listing and the string "2.4GHz" also appears on the cited US-store page; model identity confirmed by matching name, timecode/32-bit float/130 dB SPL/IPX5 feature set, and the ULTRA01/ULTRA03 SKU family. onboardRecordingHrs left null (capacity given only as 8 GB, never in hours) and outputInterface left null (modular receiver with swappable 3.5 mm/USB-C/Lightning outputs, no single stated connector).

products.name: Shure MoveMic Two Receiver Kit
products.priceNote: SoundGuys review (Mar 22, 2024) lists "Price $499" and "MSRP: $499.00" for the Shure MoveMic Two Receiver Kit (MV-TWO-KIT-Z7). US MSRP.
products.provenance: The Shure manufacturer product page (SKU MV-TWO-KIT-Z7) confirms this is the MoveMic Two Receiver Kit — a complete system bundling two MoveMic wireless lavalier transmitters, a charging case, and the MoveMic Receiver (3.5mm TRS + USB-C outputs), with eight hours per-mic battery and 24 hours total via the case. The dated SoundGuys review (Mar 22, 2024) corroborates the identity ("Model Number MV-TWO-KIT-Z7"), the US price ("$499" / "MSRP: $499.00"), a March 5, 2024 release, 8g transmitter weight, 30m range, no onboard recording, and no 32-bit float. Because this category requires a receiver-based complete kit, the Receiver Kit SKU (not the receiver-less $349 MoveMic Two) is the correct match; rfBandType is 2.4GHz+BT since the transmitters use Bluetooth 5.0 direct-to-phone and a 2.4 GHz link to the receiver, and latency and max SPL are not disclosed on any fetched page (null).
